verdict.rationale: PayPal explicitly documents Platforms/Marketplace onboarding of global sellers with local compliance, Payouts API for sending money to multiple recipients/vendors in various currencies, and REST/webhook infrastructure for building custom payment/checkout flows on top of it — directly covering seller onboarding, split/payout logic, and platform integration. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'split payment' primitive (e.g., dedicated marketplace fee-splitting API) is cited, and no independent hands-on marketplace build case study is present.
